pages.content:
📘 PF Guidebook

PF Guidebook is a powerful in-game guide and information system designed to give your server a clean, professional, and fully manageable knowledge hub. Replace messy Discord channels, outdated documents, and basic help menus with a structured guidebook that players can access anytime directly in-game.
Create categories, add pages, organize content, and update information live without restarting the server. Whether you're displaying city rules, job tutorials, department SOPs, or general server information, PF Guidebook keeps everything structured, searchable, and easy to navigate.

✨ Features

• Fully in-game editable guidebook
• Create unlimited categories and pages
• Live editing without server restart
• Job and grade-based permissions
• Rich text formatting support
• Images, videos, and embedded content
• GPS waypoint buttons inside pages
• Searchable content system
• Clean and modern UI
• Works with QBCore, ESX, and standalone
• Server-side stored content
• Perfect for rules, SOPs, tutorials, and guides

🧠 Built For Serious Servers

PF Guidebook is built for communities that want a professional onboarding experience. Help new players understand your city, provide departments with structured documentation, and give everyone instant access to important information without leaving the game.

From beginner guides to advanced roleplay procedures, everything can be organized and delivered exactly how you want.

📍 Examples Of Use

• Server rules & roleplay guidelines
• Beginner / starter guide
• Police & EMS SOP documentation
• Job tutorials and instructions
• Business information
• City laws and regulations
• Command reference pages
• FAQ and help sections

🚀 Clean, Fast, And Fully Customizable

PF Guidebook is designed to be lightweight, responsive, and easy to manage. Add new content in seconds, restrict access by job or rank, and keep your server documentation always up to date.

Give your players the information they need, exactly when they need it. 📘
